home.subtitle: Secure and efficient AI API aggregation and management platform
home.feature_gateway_desc: Single entry point for multiple AI platforms with unified API format and seamless provider switching.
home.feature_security_desc: API key management, IP whitelisting/blacklisting, and quota limits for comprehensive API security.
home.feature_channels_desc: Configure upstream channels centrally: multi-key rotation, priority scheduling, and automatic failover.
home.feature_analytics_desc: Real-time monitoring of requests, token usage, and costs with multi-dimensional data analysis.
home.feature_keys_desc: Multi-key group management with customizable quotas, expiration, and fine-grained access control.
home.feature_multi_platform_desc: Built-in support for OpenAI, Anthropic, and other major platforms, ready to use out of the box.
